Catering Facilities

Facilities Management Office University Facilities Catering Facilities

There are a total of five catering outlets on the campus which offer a wide range of food and beverages to suit different needs of the University community. All HKMU staff and students can enjoy a discount on food and beverage purchases at the catering outlets on campus. The University's Catering Committee oversees the food and service quality of the caterers. Students are welcome to voice their opinions through the student representative of the Catering Committee, or directly to the caterers.
